review_policy.primary_population: Every default-selected question from all 24 snapshots in both history modes, including sessions with no output.
review_policy.secondary_population: First non-empty raw output per bundled geist per mode, plus all selected word-burst questions and all executor errors. This is a declared diagnostic sample, not a quality estimate of all raw suggestions.
review_policy.useful_candidate: Evidence supports a specific comparison or bounded experiment not already stated by the cited notes; a fictional-author judgment, not a user rating.
review_policy.already_known: Restates the launch, completion, terminology change, seasonal routine or an explicit connection without adding a useful question.
review_policy.generic_or_weak: Valid note references but interchangeable wording, a tenuous analogy or unnecessary work without a concrete reason.
review_policy.misleading: Contradicts source facts, treats an absence as abandonment, implies false historical provenance, or makes a measurement claim unsupported by its evidence.
review_policy.abstention: Record separately; healthy emptiness is neither usefulness nor failure.
review_policy.no_retuning: Do not change the corpus, ledger, model thresholds or selected seeds after inspecting outputs. Corrections must retain original receipts and identify a new corpus version.

scenarios.facts: The harbour archive opens and is handed to the registrar in June 2024. Later stewardship continues; declining new writing is expected, not abandonment.

scenarios.bad: Prescribe reviving a forgotten project, or announce its known completion as a discovery.

scenarios.facts: A shorter route, permission to pause, a care decision and a bounded repair service all preserve the option to refuse or stop. They are not evidence of low motivation.

scenarios.bad: Recommend removing exit options to increase commitment.

scenarios.facts: Only the normal five-question selection is saved per session. Later novelty filtering can suppress previously saved questions. Raw candidates were never all presented to Mara.
scenarios.useful: Retain denominator counts for raw, filtered, selected and saved output; inspect repetitions and disjoint later evidence.
scenarios.bad: Call an unsaved raw question a previously shown question or count all generated candidates as useful.
